Form Index.Unnamed: 2: This is an example CRF used to collect all adverse experiences that occurred after informed consent is obtained. Adverse experiences were collected using free-text. This CRF was designed to allow the sponsor to use either AEENRF or AEENRTPT to represent an event that was ongoing. [en]

TIG_AE_ADV_EXP.Unnamed: 2: What is the severity of the adverse experience?
TIG_AE_ADV_EXP.Unnamed: 11:
AESEV [CDASH]
AESEV [SDTM]
The reporting physician/healthcare professional will assess the severity of the adverse experience using applicant-defined categories. This assessment is subjective and the reporting physician/healthcare professional should use medical judgment to compare the reported AE to similar type experiences observed in clinical practice. Severity is not equivalent to seriousness. [completionInstructions]
Severity [prompt]

AESER [CDASH]
AESER [SDTM]

Serious [prompt]

TIG_AE_ADV_EXP.Unnamed: 11:
AESDTH [CDASH]
AESDTH [SDTM]
Record whether the serious adverse experience resulted in death. [completionInstructions]

TIG_AE_ADV_EXP.Unnamed: 2: Was the adverse experience life threatening?
TIG_AE_ADV_EXP.Unnamed: 11:
AESLIFE [CDASH]
AESLIFE [SDTM]

Life Threatening [prompt]

TIG_AE_ADV_EXP.Unnamed: 11:
AESHOSP [CDASH]
AESHOSP [SDTM]

TIG_AE_ADV_EXP.Unnamed: 2: Did the adverse experience result in disability or permanent damage?

AESDISAB [CDASH]
AESDISAB [SDTM]
Record whether the serious adverse experience resulted in a persistent or significant disability or incapacity. [completionInstructions]

AESMIE [CDASH]
AESMIE [SDTM]
Record whether the serious adverse experience is an important medical event, which may be defined in the protocol or in the investigator brochure. [completionInstructions]

AEREL [SDTM]
